title: Frontend: Get Result By Path
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Get Result By Path. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution({value,path,fallback}). path is an array of own-property string/index segments. Return fallback when any segment is absent. Never traverse inherited properties; null is a present value.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Prefer a path-segment array for an unambiguous contract.
alternativeApproaches: Add a string-path parser that supports escaping and explicitly forbids unsafe prototype-related traversal.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Missing parent; array index; key containing a dot.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
